data.one_liner: Generates Flutter app launcher icons across all platforms from a source image.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool that creates and integrates app launcher icons for Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single high-resolution source image. It supports flavors, native configuration wiring, and modern icon variants like Android monochrome layers and iOS dark/tinted appearances.
use_when: You need to generate and set up app launcher icons across multiple platforms automatically.
Your project utilizes build flavors and requires distinct launcher icons per flavor.
avoid_when: You prefer to manually design and place every platform-specific native icon asset by hand.
strengths: Actively maintained fork with comprehensive multi-platform support including web and desktop.
Supports build flavors out-of-the-box across all platforms.
Performs deep native wiring with safe cleanup and strict validation.
weaknesses: The built-in SVG renderer is beta quality and has limitations with complex text or filters.
Diverged heavily from older tools and features a breaking config schema.
data.setup_notes: Add launcher_icons to dev_dependencies, create a configuration file or use pubspec.yaml, and run `dart run launcher_icons`.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: The original legacy tool, if you rely on older configuration schemas and are not using this maintained fork.

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  launcher_icons: "^0.16.0"

launcher_icons:
  image_path: "assets/icon/icon.png"
  android:
    generate: true
  ios:
    generate: true
